嚣张的小乞丐
“你认识我！
？“
看着面前的隋缘，龙啸面上同样有些惊讶，不过很快便反应了过来，眼前这少年应当是在平川城见过自己。
看着面前少了一条左臂的龙啸，咽了口唾沫，隋缘开口道，“你是如意门的二当家龙啸？“
“现在已经不是了！
“龙啸轻叹一声，面上有些感慨。
就在两人说话间，后面的山贼已经追了上来，看到隋缘和龙啸在那里一问一答，两人在后面踌躇了一番，其中一人上前道，”
朋友，这小子拿了我们的东西，还请将他交给我们。
“我没有！”
隋缘见状立即开口道，“是他们在外面的官道上拦路抢劫，我只不过是暴露了行踪便被他们追杀了。”
“拦路抢劫！”
龙啸闻言，目光从眼前两名山贼身上扫过，看他们的打扮心中便已信了隋缘的话。
“上。”
两名山贼察觉到龙啸的面色变化，低喝一声，闪身冲了上来。
“找死。”
龙啸见状冷笑一声，抬手将隋缘拨到一旁，闪身迎了上去，三人很快便战在了一起。
虽然少了一条手臂，但毕竟是如意门的二当家，身上功夫远不是两个不入流的山贼能比的了的，三两下的功夫便将两个山贼打在地上动弹不得。
“哼，“看着在地上打滚的两人，龙啸眼中闪过一抹不屑，”

土鸡瓦沟。
说完，转身招呼隋缘向山林深处走去。
然而龙啸刚刚迈步，只听一道凄厉的尖啸声传出，一道焰火骤然在高空中炸开。
“焰火传讯！
龙啸转身看了眼高空，双眼微微眯了起来。
一般的山贼是不会使用这种焰火的，他们都是能打就打，打不过就跑，传讯摇人这种事情向来都是有来历的江湖势力才会用。
就在龙啸正在思量着是不是留下来等等看的时候，一阵枝叶晃动的声音传来，龙啸抬头看去，却只看到一道白光向着自己的面前袭来。
心中一惊，龙啸猛地向后仰头，上半身向后折，险之又险的躲过了飞来的暗器。
“咄“的一声从身后传来，一柄短刺已经尽数没入身后的树干，只留一个手柄在外面剧烈的颤动。
刚刚起身，龙啸面前已经多了一个头发蓬乱、衣衫褴褛，但一双眼睛却又十分明亮的少年。

Arrogant little beggar
"You know me!
? "
Looking at Sui Yuan in front of him, Long Xiao was also a little surprised, but he quickly realized that the young man in front of him should have seen him in Pingchuan City.
Looking at Long Xiao who was missing his left arm in front of him, Sui Yuan swallowed and said, "Are you Long Xiao, the second head of the Ruyi Sect?"
"Not anymore!
"Long Xiao sighed softly, with some emotion on his face.
While the two were talking, the bandits behind them had already caught up. Seeing Sui Yuan and Long Xiao asking and answering questions, the two hesitated behind them, and one of them stepped forward and said, "
Friends, this guy took our stuff, please give him to us.
"I didn't! "
When Sui Yuan saw this, he immediately said, "They were blocking the road and robbing me on the official road outside. I was chased by them just because I exposed my whereabouts. "
“Highway robbery! "
When Long Xiao heard this, his eyes swept over the two bandits in front of him, and he believed Sui Yuan's words when he saw how they were dressed.
"Up. "
The two bandits noticed the change in Long Xiao's expression, shouted low, and rushed forward.
"Seeking death. "
Long Xiao sneered when he saw this, raised his hand to push Sui Yuan aside, and stepped forward to meet him. The three of them soon fought together.
Although he was missing an arm, he was still the second in command of the Ruyi Sect, and his skills were far beyond the comparison of two lowly bandits. In just a few strokes, he knocked the two bandits to the ground unable to move.
"Huh," looking at the two people rolling on the ground, a flash of disdain flashed in Long Xiao's eyes, "
Native chicken tile ditch.
After saying that, he turned around and called Sui Yuan to walk deeper into the forest.
However, just as Long Xiao took a step forward, he heard a shrill scream and a firework suddenly exploded high in the sky.
"Fireworks message!
Long Xiao turned around and looked at the sky, his eyes narrowed slightly.
Ordinary bandits would not use this kind of fireworks. They would fight if they could, and run away if they couldn't. This kind of thing was only used by powerful people with good backgrounds.
Just when Long Xiao was thinking about whether to stay and wait and see, there was a sound of swaying branches and leaves. Long Xiao looked up, but only saw a white light coming towards him.
Shocked in his heart, Long Xiao suddenly tilted his head back and folded his upper body backwards, narrowly dodging the flying hidden weapon.
A sound of "duh" came from behind, and all the short thorns were buried in the tree trunk behind him, leaving only one handle shaking violently outside.
Just as he stood up, a young man with disheveled hair, ragged clothes, but bright eyes appeared in front of Long Xiao.
